verdict.rationale: Mercury natively supports opening multiple checking accounts and internal transfers between them (mercury-docs-57, mercury-docs-39), and a long-time customer explicitly describes running 'dozens of purpose-named accounts with auto-funding rules' (mercury-comm-1), corroborating auto-allocation of deposits. However, this auto-allocation capability is not documented in Mercury's own first-party product pages or API docs — only confirmed anecdotally. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of an 'auto-allocation'/auto-funding-rules feature, configuration UI details, and independent corroboration beyond a single community post.
